handbook.deals.title: Negotiated deals
handbook.deals.body: Put money, regions and treaties on the two sides of the table. The review uses exactly the other government's own assessment; diplomatic points are not dollars. The first send click asks for confirmation; the second submits the same package. An invalid or refused package moves nothing. Each country must retain actual land, and occupied regions cannot be sold. Existing treaties cannot be sold again.
handbook.domestic_crises.title: Domestic crises
handbook.domestic_crises.body: The Crises tab in Laws shows pressure, causes, sustained exposure and the actual threshold. 100% public awareness alone is not rebellion. National pressure and a capital military plot share outcome protection: one successful transition cannot trigger a second coup the next day. Paid responses take time and have cooldowns. Regional crises still have their own conditions; a gauge is not a promise that every country will collapse.
handbook.territorial_titles.title: Territory: ownership, control, titles
handbook.territorial_titles.body: A province's owner is not necessarily its military controller. Homeland titles come from scenario cores or remembered original homeland; disputed claims are weaker interests. Splitting a region preserves those titles, and giving up a claim gives up every piece of the old region. Governments go after their lost homeland first, but only in a war they can win.
handbook.organizations.title: International organizations
handbook.organizations.body: Open Conflicts → Organizations or use the diplomacy header. Found a council with a named charter and a real deposit. Members pay GDP-based weekly dues into a separate fund. Every member can propose admission or funded aid; votes close after the charter's deadline. Majority means a majority of all members; unanimity requires all of them. Admission still needs the invited country's consent. Arrears weaken cohesion; collective defence is suspended below 25%. Defence does not mean joining a partner's offensive war. A human player answers a defensive call explicitly. Leaving removes obligations and creates a cooling-off truce; the last member receives the remaining fund.
handbook.households.title: Households and demographic change
handbook.households.body: Employment adjusts gradually to formal and non-building jobs. Food, energy and pharmaceutical coverage come from actual market satisfaction, not treasury balances. Shortages, job losses and local war damage feed livelihood stress, wealth, living standards and radicalism. Literacy, living conditions and hospital capacity per resident influence aggregate births and deaths. Totals stay conserved across population groups. These are game rates, not an age-cohort or migration model. The factory staffing share shown elsewhere is not the same as household employment.
